Copyright 2019 The Manrope Project Authors (https://github.com/sharanda/manrope)
Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)

Both fonts in this directory are licensed under the SIL Open Font License,
Version 1.1. The licence text is in OFL.txt beside this notice, and it applies
to both families.

The copyright notice above travels with the fonts because the licence requires
it: a copy of the font that is redistributed has to carry the notice of the
copyright holder and the licence. One notice naming both families satisfies
that for both, and the licence text itself is the same one.

  manrope-latin-wght-normal.woff2        Manrope, latin subset
  manrope-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2     Manrope, latin-ext subset
  jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2  JetBrains Mono, latin subset

Manrope is the interface face. JetBrains Mono is the monospace face, used for
code, identifiers and the places where a fixed measure matters.

Neither font is sold on its own, and neither is modified: the files here are
the upstream releases, subset to the ranges the interface needs. The subsets
were produced with the upstream tools, and the licence permits subsetting and
redistribution as long as the font is not sold by itself and the notice and
the licence travel with it.
